excluded_data.reason: Zero-like aged standard below the current blank distribution; retained as diagnostic only.

limitations: Concentrations were derived from the same earlier two-point calibration and are not independent reference values.
Standards were more than one week old at the time of measurement.
Five of six positive levels showed lower signal on the second measurement, consistent with photobleaching/time drift.
The pipette and tips used to prepare the standards were later found to be unreliable.
The excitation LED was not yet mechanically rigid.
This file is intended only to test firmware import, prediction, prediction intervals, range flags, LOD/LOQ display and CSV output.
